gaps.description: The selected evidence does not provide representative authorized mailbox labels that jointly cover reply parents, ancestry, Groups, quote-source spans, semantic response scope and unique decision-bearing contributions. This is an annotation and validation need, not a claim that academic datasets do not exist.
gaps.resolution_notes: In a separately authorized follow-up, define a representative mailbox sample with actual clients, languages, organizations, time periods, forwards, subject changes, branches, malformed or duplicate identifiers and incomplete exports. Use independent annotation and adjudication for direct parents, ancestry, Group membership, quote occurrences and source spans, semantic response spans, and unique and decision-bearing contributions. Keep Group separate from Topic. Permit multiple parents, unresolved endpoints and annotator disagreement. Include partial approvals and sibling-visibility cases. Keep complete conversations and quote/template families separate across training, calibration and test sets; audit near duplicates without presuming leakage occurred. Compare deterministic, feature and selected neural or later LLM-assisted candidates on the same labels and scorers. Report edge precision/recall, ancestry and Group errors, exact and overlap span scores, rare-class support, denominator-zero cases and uncertainty intervals separately. No mailbox access, collection, labeling or experiment is authorized or performed by this classification.

gaps.description: Unique and decision-bearing text preservation across HTML/plain-text alternatives, conversion, zoning, duplicate handling and downstream views remains unmeasured. Line accuracy, retained raw bytes or improved term retrieval cannot establish preservation of every decision.
gaps.resolution_notes: Propose a future benchmark over retained MIME, HTML and plain-text representations with exact source-offset mappings. Include nested tables and blockquotes, divergent MIME alternatives, mixed copied/new text on one line, markerless or edited quotes, wrapping, format=flowed, forward headers, short approvals, corrections and template-field changes. Do not treat signature, disclaimer, quote or template labels as permission to discard content. Check conversion, zoning, deduplication, packaging and display separately against adjudicated unique spans and decision-bearing spans; report lost-span counts and rates, token loss, affected-message counts and denominators. Keep all quotation occurrences and source provenance inspectable. Compare Graph uniqueBody with retained bodies as an input option using saved ENG-04 field definitions; the synthetic omission case is not evidence of observed live Graph behavior. Use saved RFC 3676 as an engineering reference. Report finite-test scope and observed failures; no passing test or source-retention policy establishes universal zero loss. All benchmark and application work remains deferred.

gaps.description: Late-parent resolution, arrival-order sensitivity, inference correction and stable relation/span identity require a reproducible replay experiment. None of the selected results establishes the complete required correction policy for business email.
gaps.resolution_notes: In a future authorized benchmark, replay fully observed adjudicated cases with missing ancestors, late arrivals, different arrival orders, repeated arrivals, identifier collisions, false or truncated References, multiple In-Reply-To assertions, cycles, subject changes, contradictory dates and later decision corrections. Compare intermediate and final direct-edge, ancestry and Group errors separately. Measure correction latency in arrivals and wall time, unnecessary changes, final-reference agreement, candidate-window misses, stable span identity after splitting, and cost per added message. Investigate unresolved references, versioned Stage assessments and retraction of inferred relations while retaining prior assessments and unchanged Source records; these are proposals, not an approved schema. Keep quote-source matches separate from parents and semantic corrections. Match multiple partial quotes cautiously; do not fabricate unquoted missing content or infer sibling awareness from ordering. Use saved RFC 5322, RFC 5256 and Graph immutable-ID material as engineering references. No replay, mailbox access or implementation is performed now.

gaps.description: Calibration and abstention require held-out measurements for the candidate methods and actual annotation targets. Self-links, top-k recall, matching abstentions and raw model scores do not establish calibrated confidence or distinguish a true new root from an unavailable parent.
gaps.resolution_notes: After authorization and E1 labels, reserve separate calibration and held-out test data with realistic positive-pair prevalence. Label true roots, unavailable parents, ambiguous alternatives and multiple supported targets separately. Select thresholds on calibration data; report accepted-link coverage, selective error, incorrect confident links, unresolved cases and abstentions together on held-out data. Assess reliability by relation type and relevant mailbox strata, with class supports and confidence intervals. Measure candidate-window recall on actual email labels. Keep calibration of reply edges separate from quote-source and semantic-response confidence. Compare deployable inputs with estimated parents or capacities; keep gold-root and gold-capacity oracle results as separately labeled diagnostics. Do not infer calibration from a threshold, argmax, unmatched node or evidential confidence grade. All policies, thresholds and experiments remain proposals.

gaps.resolution_notes: After separate authorization and candidate/artifact selection, benchmark on the actual Raspberry Pi 5 with 16 GB RAM, arm64 Raspberry Pi OS and NVMe storage. Record the precise environment and use arm64-compatible artifacts. Compare full-message work and per-arrival updates on the same adjudicated workload. Include long threads, large and nested HTML bodies, mixed alternatives, large candidate sets, token/line truncation, cold and warm runs and persistence. Measure mean and tail latency, throughput, peak RAM, storage growth, processing and persistence cost per message/arrival, and correctness or text loss caused by limits. research_question_coverage.question: What metadata supports reply and ancestry reconstruction when identifiers are absent, malformed, duplicated, or conflicting?
How can original text, quotations, forwards, inline replies, signatures, and disclaimers be identified without losing decision-bearing text in HTML or plain text?
Can relations connect spans or multiple parent messages, with unresolved references and uncertainty preserved?
How can forks, missing ancestors, late arrivals, and corrections be represented and evaluated without inventing participant knowledge?
What evidence supports deterministic, statistical, neural, and LLM-assisted methods, and under what data and computational assumptions?
Which datasets and annotations cover email phenomena, and what leakage, licensing, availability, and domain-transfer limits remain?
How should reply edges, ancestry, grouping, quotation alignment, unique-span loss, abstention, and incremental correction be measured?
What minimal representation and evaluation experiments should msgloom investigate, and which decisions remain hypotheses?
